limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

Mail absence was observed after the pg-boss queue settled plus a 4 s quiet window, paired with positive deliveries through the same worker. This bounds the lab relay, not a real mailbox, spam filter, or delivery retry.

Morning rounds were queued as notification.morning-round jobs instead of waiting for the hourly cron. The worker ran them with its real clock and rules. Timezones were America/New_York (after 08:00) and Pacific/Honolulu (before 08:00) at the run time; UTC fallback for a person with no saved timezone was not exercised.

Not produced in this lab: Entity and Obligation reminders, Contract notice deadline and expiry reminders, Knowledge-only briefings, Approvals, Document Versions and signature events, Matter conversion notifications in the Portal, generated Contracts, and a duplicate email from a delivery retry.
The Portal gear icon in the header was selected by its accessible name, Notification settings. The Administrator lead-time procedure is in the reminders guide and was not repeated here.
Contributor behaviour is not a required role for V-C08 and was not re-run in round 2.

The work lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Records created are named DOC-029 conversations * 205399. Nadia Haddad's unread notifications were marked read by the Mark all read step. Amara Nwosu was removed from C-312 afterwards; preference switches changed during checks were restored.
